doc: Applies an interpolation curve to progress, or slices out a sub-range and interpolates within it. Set either 'interp', or both 'offset' and 'duration'. Applied via PartProgress's 'op'/'operation' field (e.g. `op: curve`), NOT 'type' - its parameter fields (if any) are written flat alongside 'op', on the same object.

interp.doc: Interpolation curve to apply directly to progress.

offset.doc: Start of the sub-range to slice out.

duration.doc: Length of the sub-range to slice out.
